title: facts-section-v1

meetings.$comment: required field: [] means online (unambiguous - the field can never be absent); never invent times

credit_hours.$comment: semester credit hours from the schedule CSV (needed for F-1 full-time load and multi-course credit budgeting)

session.$comment: sub-term within the semester: winter | flex_dec..flex_aug | 8wk1 | 8wk2 | may | summer1 | summer2 | full. Derived from class_features/dates; drives compressed-term staleness fallback. null when the source has no session label.

syllabus.$comment: the offering's syllabus facts (a full facts-syllabus-v1 object), EMBEDDED here so a section and its syllabus are ONE row. Present only on the offering's REPRESENTATIVE section (the one whose syllabus was fetched); sibling sections of the same professor+course+modality carry syllabus_ref instead. Exactly one of syllabus / syllabus_ref is non-null once a syllabus exists; both null = no syllabus fetched yet (staleness fallback fires).

syllabus_source_url.$comment: the Concourse view_syllabus URL the embedded syllabus came from - REQUIRED for DP-013 citations, since this row's own source_url is the schedule CSV. Non-null whenever syllabus is non-null.

syllabus_ref.$comment: source_url of the sibling section row that carries facts.syllabus for this offering (one point-read away). Serving a sibling's syllabus always renders the DP-041 provenance label ('based on the syllabus for section N').

$comment: Starter contract (issue #36). Issue #51 finalizes and CI-pins it against the SQLAlchemy models. Nulls mean 'the source didn't say' - never invent values. Evolving a shape = copy to vN+1 and bump schema_version stamps.
